operative_text.controlling:
2.25(1)  The duties of a lawyer of record include:
(a) to conduct the action in a manner that furthers the purpose
and intention of these rules described in rule 1.2;
(b) to continue to act as lawyer of record while the lawyer is
recorded in that capacity.
(2)  On application, the Court may direct a lawyer of record to
disclose the address of the party for whom the lawyer acts.

BOOK_A.title: Duties of Lawyer of Record
BOOK_A.related_provisions: 4.2 (duties of parties) ; 6.18 (duty of lawyer served with appointment) ; 9.2 (duty to prepare orders); 10.49 (sanctions) ; 10.50 (costs payable by lawyer) ; 11.15 (address for service) ; 11.16 (service on lawyer) ; 11.17 (service on lawyer of record).
BOOK_A.commentary:
A client got relief where her lawyer let a motion go by default before the lawyer’s steps to cease
to act were effective.¹
On conﬂicts of interest of solicitors, see R.2.24n.
Counsel who gets bail pending his client’s appeal incurs personal obligations to keep the
matter (or appeal) pending, and if the client hires someone else, the ﬁrst counsel should apply to
the court to be relieved of his obligations.²
On whether a lawyer owes a ﬁduciary duty to his or her employee, see the Perez case.³
A lawyer can be sanctioned by his professional organization for having written a disrespectful,
insulting letter to a judge, and the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms does not bar such
discipline.⁴
